title: Sending off dismissal not given: challenge by Fatawu on Mbuemo
summary: Sending off dismissal not given: Challenge by Fatawu on Mbuemo. Panel: The referee's call of no red card for a challenge by Fatawu on Mbuemo was unanimously supported as correct. The challenge was low, reckless, and lacking the excessive force required for serious foul play.
